correctness.rationale: Write A_k=[A_{k-1} v;0 0], B_k=[B_{k-1} b;0 0]. Condition A_k B_k=0 is A_{k-1}B_{k-1}=0 and A_{k-1}b=0, with independent free v. For predecessor rank s there are q^{k-1-s} b choices; q^s v lie in the column space and q^{k-1}-q^s raise rank. This yields exactly C_{k,r}=q^{k-1}C_{k-1,r}+q^{k-r}(q^{k-1}-q^{r-1})C_{k-1,r-1}, with base n=1. Checked direct small-matrix multiplication and recurrence for (q,n)=(2,2),(3,2),(2,3),(3,3),(2,4), counts 4,9,48,405,1664; valid unrestricted argument works for any finite field, including nonprime orders. Circle equality is equivalent to AB=0 and |J_n|^2=q^{n(n-1)}.
residual_risks: Ordered one-sided AB=0, not simultaneous AB=BA=0; no general non-niltriangular algebra census and no asymptotic probability estimate.
